name: herdr-agent-diagram
description: Herdr desktop app add-ons for coding agents: pinned Mermaid diagrams and a native Excalidraw canvas

scripts.build:mod: bun build src/canvas-mod/main.ts --outdir dist/mods/excal-canvas --target browser --format esm --external gpui-kit --external gpui-base --external herdr --external websocket --external gpui-fps && cp src/canvas-mod/mod.json dist/mods/excal-canvas/ && bun scripts/check-bundle.ts dist/mods/excal-canvas/main.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
